title: capability-announce seq not persistent: post-reboot rejoin can be REPLAY_DETECTED-locked by root floor
description: Security review of 99sg.2 (pass 2, finding 4): node.py comment claims every re-announce recipient is a NEW root with no cached seq floor, but after a node process restart DodagState resets and the first rejoin records (None, root) — the recipient can be the SAME root whose CapabilityTable._seq_floors survives purge_expired (capability_announce.py:90-100,150-157). The node restarts seq at 1 and is rejected (REPLAY_DETECTED -> 4.03) until seq climbs past the old floor, one per root-change event: potential indefinite lockout. Related: l1qw.20 covers persistent claim_seq machinery for GCP slot claims; this is the spec-8.12 capability-announce analogue.
